title: SingLEM: Single-Channel Large EEG Model
abstract: arXiv:2509.17920v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current deep learning models for electroencephalography (EEG) are often task-specific and depend on large labeled datasets, limiting their adaptability. Although EEG foundation models seek broader applicability, many still rely on predefined multi-channel inputs, electrode-layout assumptions, or model-specific channel handling. To address these limitations, we introduce the Single-Channel Large EEG Model (SingLEM), a self-supervised foundation model whose hybrid convolutional--Transformer encoder maps each channel independently to a reusable representation capturing local and long-range temporal structure. These representations can be used individually or combined through channel-wise feature concatenation. We assembled 71 public EEG datasets comprising approximately 9,200 subjects and 357,000 single-channel hours. translated_title: SingLEM：单通道大型脑电图模型
translated_abstract: 当前用于脑电图（EEG）的深度学习模型通常是任务特定的，并依赖大量标注数据，这限制了其适应性。尽管脑电图基础模型试图实现更广泛的适用性，但许多模型仍依赖预定义的多通道输入、电极布局假设或模型特定的通道处理方式。为解决这些局限，我们提出了单通道大型脑电图模型，这是一个自监督基础模型，其混合卷积-Transformer编码器将每个通道独立映射为可复用的表示，从而捕获局部和长程时间结构。这些表示既可以单独使用，也可以通过通道级特征拼接进行组合。我们收集了71个公开脑电图数据集，包含约9,200名受试者和357,000小时的单通道数据。为进行防数据泄漏的评估，下游实验结果是使用在排除了相应数据集后、由68个数据集预训练得到的模型获得的。
tldr: 提出了SingLEM，一个自监督脑电图基础模型，通过混合卷积-Transformer编码器独立处理每个通道，摆脱了预定义多通道输入和电极布局假设的限制，并在71个公开数据集（约9,200名受试者、357,000小时单通道数据）上训练，显著提升了模型的通用适应性。
en_tdlr: SingLEM is a self-supervised EEG foundation model with a hybrid convolutional-Transformer encoder that independently encodes each channel into reusable representations, eliminating the need for predefined multi-channel inputs or electrode-layout assumptions, and is pretrained on 71 public EEG datasets covering about 9,200 subjects and 357,000 single-channel hours for broad adaptability.
